body.name: Observable main-prefix standard error and gate
body.construction: On \(E_T\), let \(\widehat\sigma_{X,a,\Delta}^2\) be the usual sample variance of the \(K_a(n_T)\) main-prefix variables in arm \(a\), set \(\widehat s_{T,\Delta}^2=\widehat\sigma_{X,1,\Delta}^2/K_1(n_T)+\widehat\sigma_{X,0,\Delta}^2/K_0(n_T)\), and set \(G_{T,\Delta}=\{\widehat\sigma_{X,1,\Delta}^2+\mathbf 1\{\alpha=0\}\widehat\sigma_{X,0,\Delta}^2\geq2/\log T\}\). On \(E_T^c\), set \(\widehat s_{T,\Delta}=0\) and \(G_{T,\Delta}=\varnothing\).
